Rhubarb Whip
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 9:31am

Ingredients




4 cups rhubarb, cut in 1" pieces
cup sugar
cup water
2 pkts strawberry Jello, (3 oz.)
cup water
1 pkt Dream Whip, whipped

Preparation

1 Combine rhubarb, sugar and 1/4 cup water. Bring to boil and stir. Cover and cook 10 minutes. Add Jello to dissolve. Stir in 1/2 cup water. Chill until partially set. Beat until fluffy. Fold in Dream Whip. Chill. 2 Hannah Guth
